description: Removes the link between two thoughts, with its label. There is no undo. Requires human confirmation. Call it only when the user asked for the link to go. brain_link with replace changes a link's kind; a tag goes with brain_tag, a type with brain_update_thought.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

confirm.description: Set to true only after a human has confirmed the deletion. Do not decide this on their behalf.

name: brain_unlink
